claims.claim: Reading aloud to infants improves later language development
claims.testedAs: Reading aloud to infants improves later language development

nhs.says: Looking at books and singing with your child helps them develop language and communication skills.

aap.says: Reading together builds the foundation for healthy social-emotional, cognitive, language and literacy development.
